policy: A critical advisory always blocks. A high advisory on a direct dependency blocks unless it is listed here with a reason, a scope, and a review date within 12 months. Anything accepted here is re-checked on the review date and whenever the dependency is upgraded.

accepted.reason: The advisory is in bigint-buffer (native binding wrapper), pulled in transitively by @solana/buffer-layout-utils. The browser build resolves bigint-buffer to dist/browser.js (pure JS, no native binding), and every value it decodes comes from an SPL token account the wallet itself owns, bounded to 8-byte amounts. No path feeds it attacker-sized buffers. Upstream fix requires a @solana/spl-token major downgrade (0.1.8) that would break the token instruction API, so it is tracked rather than forced.
accepted.scope: transitive, pure-JS browser path, bounded input

accepted.reason: Dev-server and launch-editor advisories: none of this code exists in the built dist/ that GitHub Pages serves (only hashed static assets). Exploiting them requires running `npm run dev` on a hostile network. Upgrade to Vite 7 is a separate, non-security-critical maintenance step.
